# US Open 2026: Dates, schedule & full calendar

The US Open 2026 runs from August 23 to September 13 at Flushing Meadows, New York – 22 days of tennis, the longest edition in the tournament’s history. Here’s the full schedule, round by round.

Don’t forget about the doubles tournament and the juniors tournament, both of which kick off September 3rd. For grit and greatness, you can’t beat the wheelchair tournament, which starts September 8th.
 Don’t talk loudly during matches, and don’t take calls. It’s not exactly Wimbledon-level etiquette at the U.S. Open, and we like it that way. But be considerate. results.content:
This year's US Open will get undway on Monday 24 August through to Sunday 13 September.

This year's qualifying week will welcome the return of the Mixed Doubles event which is set to see a host of doubles specialists and singles stars compete for the title..

Meanwhile, a host of British talent are set to contest the title across the women's singles, men's singles, doubles and wheelchair tennis draws.
